deficiencies.description: The rewrite turns the lecturer's pointing words into a specific spatial relation ('lies next to') that the text does not state or confirm.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

deficiencies.description: The rewrite uses 'therefore' to present the tumour being circumscribed as a result or effect of the tissue preparation process, whereas the lecturer was merely pointing out what can be observed ('So you can see again that...').
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour is therefore circumscribed and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.

considerations.reason: Replacing 'circumspect' with 'circumscribed' corrects a lecturer slip or transcription error to the scientifically correct histological term for a well-demarcated benign tumour.

considerations.sourcePassage: So contrast this fibroid that you're seeing here, this leiomyoma, with a malignant case.
considerations.reason: Phrasing this as 'This fibroid, a leiomyoma, can be contrasted with a malignant case' preserves the original meaning and technical terms.
